<thought>We need to apply retrosynthetic template ID 149040 to each of the three product SMILES provided in the previous answer. Using the apply_template tool will give us the precursor sets for each product. We'll then format the result as a list of lists, each inner list containing the SMILES strings of the precursors for that product.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C", "template_id": "149040"}</action_input>
